name: John
lede: The Gospel according to John, in full: in the beginning was the Word; the Lamb of God; water made wine; Nicodemus by night and the woman at the well; the bread of life, the light of the world, the good shepherd; Lazarus come forth; the washing of feet, the upper room and the prayer; the cross and the empty tomb; and by the sea at dawn, lovest thou me? — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Word Became Flesh
books.blurb: In the beginning was the Word, and the light shineth in the darkness; a man sent from God whose name was John; the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us; the voice of one crying in the wilderness; behold, the Lamb of God; the Spirit descending as a dove; come and see; we have found the Messiah; Nathanael under the fig tree; the water become wine at Cana; and the scourge of cords in the temple — destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

books.name: Ye Must Be Born Anew
books.blurb: Nicodemus by night — except one be born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God; the wind bloweth where it will; as Moses lifted up the serpent; God so loved the world; he must increase, but I must decrease; then Jacob's well at the sixth hour and the woman of Samaria — give me to drink, living water, in spirit and truth, I that speak unto thee am he; the fields white already unto harvest; and the nobleman's son at Capernaum — go thy way; thy son liveth.

books.name: The Bread of Life
books.blurb: The pool of Bethesda with its five porches and the man of thirty and eight years — arise, take up thy bed, and walk; my Father worketh even until now, and I work; the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; John the lamp that burneth and shineth; then five barley loaves and two fishes on the much grass, twelve baskets over, the boat in the dark — it is I; be not afraid; I am the bread of life; and Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

books.name: Before Abraham Was
books.blurb: The feast of tabernacles — my time is not yet come; my teaching is not mine; on the last great day, if any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink, and rivers of living water; never man so spake; the woman taken in adultery — he that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone, neither do I condemn thee; I am the light of the world; the truth shall make you free; and before Abraham was born, I am.

books.name: The Good Shepherd
books.blurb: The man blind from his birth — go, wash in the pool of Siloam, and he came seeing; the neighbours, the Pharisees, his father and mother afraid; one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see; Lord, I believe; then the fold of the sheep — I am the door; I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep; other sheep I have; and in Solomon's porch in winter, I and the Father are one.
